BLUE REFLECTION Quartet, combines all four titles in the fan-favorite franchise into one magical package. The new collection includes the console games BLUE REFLECTION and BLUE REFLECTION: Second Light; the anime series BLUE REFLECTION RAY; and the mobile game BLUE REFLECTION SUN.

The collection also includes a reference database, which will allow players to deepen their understanding of the BLUE REFLECTION universe, enabling fans to check flowcharts with certain events organized in chronological order, characters’ relationship charts, and even series correlation charts. description:
Mistfall Hunter, the highly anticipated dark fantasy extraction ARPG, now goes live on PlayStation 5! Dive into the hunt immediately and take advantage of a special 10% launch discount on both the Standard and Deluxe Editions, available until August 12.
Set in Weavereach, a shattered world where the gods have perished and the deadly Gyldenmist sweeps the realm, Mistfall Hunter invites you to take on the role of a Gyldhunter. Venture into the heart of the corruption solo or with up to two companions, defeating twisted creatures for their spoils or hunting rival Gyldhunters for their loot. The stakes are high: if you die, you lose everything. To secure a safe return to the Windrest, you must track down extraction opportunities hidden within the realm and ring the bell known as the Soul of Return to escape. But beware, the Gyldenmist may conceal more than one way out. 

#ps5 #ps5games #mistfallhunter
